_comment: wave 27 (gap-closing batch 3): static-object setters + accessor over the cbuffer/pose object-literal primaries added in wave 26. cbuffer_set_srid / pose_set_srid are VOID in-place mutators serialized via the new self_out return-kind (call f(obj, srid); then obj_out(obj); then free obj). pose_orientation returns the orientation quaternion as a double array (array_out num) over a 3D pose literal. All probed green against v15 libmeos.

operators.comment_one_liner: cbuffer_set_srid (Cbuffer *) - the circular buffer with its SRID set.
pose_set_srid (Pose *) - the pose with its SRID set.
pose_orientation (double *) - the orientation quaternion of a 3D pose.
